plan: Given my private value of $6, any bid above $6 is dominated because I would incur a loss if I win. Bidding exactly $6 is also dominated as I would break even at best. The optimal strategy is to bid slightly less than my value to maximize profit if I win, while still having a chance to win against low bids from others. I'll bid $5.9, which is slightly below my value, minimizing loss potential and maximizing profit potential.

My private value is $40. Bidding above $40 is dominated as it would lead to a negative profit if I win. I must consider bids just below $40 to maximize my chance of winning while ensuring profit. A bid slightly below my value, like $39.9, can outbid others who might bid close to their values. This maximizes my chance of winning and ensures a small but positive profit.

My private value is $28. Bidding above this would guarantee a loss if I win, so bids above $28 are dominated. To maximize profit, I should bid slightly less than my value to outbid others while still securing a profit.
